title: Enforce Pod Security with Pod Security Admission and Kyverno
description: Turn on the restricted Pod Security profile for a namespace, watch it reject a default pod, then add a Kyverno ValidatingPolicy in Audit mode, read the PolicyReport, and switch it to Deny.

steps.title: Step 1: label the namespace, reject a default pod
Step 2: a pod that satisfies restricted
Step 4: a rule Pod Security cannot express, in Audit mode
